title: Observer Center
subtitle: Read-only system observability panel (master key protected)

login.title: Master Key Required
login.description: Enter the system master key (RCS_SYSTEM_API_KEYS) to view the observation dashboard. The key is kept only in sessionStorage and is never logged.

tree.selectMachine: Select a machine row to highlight its links in the ownership tree.

integrity.title: Integrity check
integrity.description: Observations whose role ids could not be aligned with the authority table, or whose key roles are missing.
integrity.possibleReasons: Possible causes: environment missing, agent config not identified yet (no placeholders), or ownership mismatch with the authority record.

states.error: Failed to load the observation view
